Introduction

Dang Hong Hai is a Vietnamese trainee under Dongyo Entertainment. He is best known for participating in the survival shows "The Voice Kids Vietnam" (2016), "Boys Planet" (2023), where he ranked 42nd place, and "Boys II Planet" (2025).

Dang Hong Hai is a member of NEWKIES (DONGYO NEW ROOKIES, a pre-debut trainee group under Dongyo Entertainment. Their debut date has not been confirmed.
